description: Remediates the deferred CLAUDE-AUTH-016 (no replay-protection / nonce) and CLAUDE-AUTH-013 (no minimum freshness window) findings. Defines a typed ApprovalPacket (approval_id nonce, timestamp_epoch_s, trace_id, workspace_identity_hash, canonical_patch_body_hash, verifier_ref, rollback_snapshot_ref) and an ApprovalReplayAndStalenessVerifier with an in-memory NonceLedger. The verifier refuses: (1) reused approval_id; (2) age > max_age_seconds (default 24h); (3) workspace hash mismatch; (4) canonical patch body hash mismatch; (5) verifier ref mismatch; (6) rollback snapshot ref mismatch; (7) malformed packet (empty, NUL, negative ts). Replay attack scenario test demonstrates a previously valid approval cannot be replayed even when the attacker swaps in a different workspace or patch body. The verifier NEVER opens source mutation; it gates the apply path's right to honor a packet.
